info.name: SustainSite API
info.description:
Sustainable Construction Project Management System — Full API collection.

## Getting Started
1. Set `baseUrl` variable if needed (default: http://localhost:5001)
2. Run **Register** or **Login** — the token is auto-saved to `{{token}}`
3. Run **Create Project** — the projectId is auto-saved to `{{projectId}}`
4. Use any downstream request freely

## Variables auto-set by test scripts
- `token` — set on Login / Register
- `projectId` — set on Create Project
- `documentId` — set on Upload Document
- `checklistId` — set on Create Checklist
- `inspectionId` — set on Create Inspection
- `metricId` — set on Create Metric
- `milestoneId` — set on Add Milestone
- `materialId` — set on Create Material
- `equipmentId` — set on Create Equipment
- `supplierId` — set on Create Supplier

Access: ADMIN, PROJECT_MANAGER, INSPECTOR

Use **form-data** body (not JSON). Select an actual file for the `file` field.

Status defaults to `Draft`. `documentId` is auto-saved.
Filters (all optional): `projectId`, `documentType`, `status`, `page`, `limit`
Also logs a `view` entry in the document's access log.

Access: ADMIN, PROJECT_MANAGER, INSPECTOR

Updates metadata only (title, description, documentType, version, tags). Does NOT replace the file.

Access: Document owner (uploadedBy) or ADMIN.

Also deletes the file from Cloudinary.
